{{nihongo|'''Toyokuni Shrine'''|豊国神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Toyokuni Shrine''' (とよくにじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} enshrined in Nakagō-chō, {{ill|Komatsushima, Tokushima|Q823493|qid=Q823493}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Tokushima|af|Tokushima-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Tokushima|ar|توكوشيما (محافظة)|az|Tokuşima prefekturası|azb|توکوشیما اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Tokushima|be|Такусіма (прэфектура)|bg|Токушима (префектура)|bn|তোকুশিমা প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura de Tokushima|cdo|Tokushima-gâing|ce|Токусима (префектура)|ceb|Tokushima-ken|ckb|پارێزگای تۆکوشیما|cs|Prefektura Tokušima|cy|Tokushima (talaith)|da|Tokushima-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Tokushima|eo|Gubernio Tokuŝimo|es|Prefectura de Tokushima|et|Tokushima prefektuur|eu|Tokushima (prefektura)|fa|استان توکوشیما|fi|Tokushiman prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Tokushima|frr|Tokushima-ken|ga|Maoracht Tokushima|gl|Prefectura de Tokushima|hak|Tokushima-yen|he|טוקושימה (מחוז)|hr|Tokushima (prefektura)|hu|Tokusima prefektúra|hy|Տոկուսիմա (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Tokushima|ilo|Prepektura ti Tokushima|it|Prefettura di Tokushima|ja|徳島県|jv|Préfèktur Tokushima|ka|ტოკუსიმის პრეფექტურა|ko|도쿠시마현|lt|Tokušimos prefektūra|lv|Tokusimas prefektūra|mk|Токушима (префектура)|mni|ꯇꯣꯀꯨꯁꯤꯃꯥ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|तोकुशिमा प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Tokushima|ne|तोकुसिमा|nl|Tokushima (prefectuur)|no|Tokushima (prefektur)|os|Токусимæ (префектурæ)|pl|Prefektura Tokushima|pnb|ضلع ٹوکوشیما|pt|Tokushima|ro|Prefectura Tokushima|ru|Токусима (префектура)|sd|ٽوڪوشيما پريفيڪچر|se|Tokushima prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Tokushima|simple|Tokushima Prefecture|sk|Tokušima (prefektúra)|sq|Prefektura Tokushima|sr|Префектура Токушима|su|Tokushima Prefecture|sv|Tokushima prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Tokushima|tg|Префектураи Токушима|th|จังหวัดโทกูชิมะ|tl|Prepektura ng Tokushima|tr|Tokushima (prefektörlük)|tt|Токусима (префектура)|uk|Префектура Токусіма|ur|توکوشیما پریفیکچر|vi|Tokushima|war|Tokushima (prefektura)|wuu|德岛县|zh|德岛县|zh_classical|德島縣|zh_min_nan|Tokusima-koān|zh_yue|德島縣|qid=Q160734}}.

=== History ===
Founded in {{ill|1614|Q6781|qid=Q6781}} ({{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}} 19). Toyorin-ji Temple was also built as its bettō temple. As the sacred object, it has a “wooden image of Taikō Toyotomi” (not publicly displayed), received from {{ill|Toyotomi Hideyori|Q313641|qid=Q313641}} by {{ill|Hachisuka Iemasa|Q1073557|qid=Q1073557}} and {{ill|Hachisuka Yoshishige|Q3125481|qid=Q3125481}} after the death of {{ill|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|Q187550|qid=Q187550}}.

At the time of foundation it was a grand major shrine, but it was dismantled because {{ill|Hachisuka Mitsutaka|Q3125458|qid=Q3125458}}, lord of the {{ill|Tokushima Domain|Q3034557|qid=Q3034557}}, feared the {{ill|Tokugawa shogunate|Q205662|qid=Q205662}} and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tokugawa family}}. In the {{ill|Shōhō|Q1146192|qid=Q1146192}} era, Toyorin-ji became abandoned. Afterward it was renamed Toyokuni Daimyōjin, Hiyoshi Daimyōjin, and Hiyoshi-no-miya, and from the {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} period it was restored under the name Toyokuni Shrine by surrounding parishioners.

In the precincts stands Mikata Shrine, a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, also called Miyakata Shrine.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|Q187550|qid=Q187550}}
** The sacred image “wooden Taikō Toyotomi image” is said to be the only surviving one of the one hundred distributed after Hideyoshi’s death.

=== Precinct shrines ===
[[File:Miagata shrine, Komatsushima, Tokushima.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Mikata Shrine]]
* Mikata Shrine - {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}. Alternate name: Miyakata Shrine. Deity is {{ill|Ōkuninushi|lt=Ōnamuchi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q276944}} or {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611}}.
* Sumiyoshi Shrine
* Yuga Shrine
* Katō Kiyomasa Shrine

=== Access ===
* About 10 minutes on foot from {{ill|Chūden Station|Q5119016|qid=Q5119016|lt=Nakata Station}} on the {{ill|Mugi Line|Q860478|qid=Q860478}} ({{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|Q496531|qid=Q496531}}).
